common.institution: Faculty of Agriculture — Ain Shams University

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your university email or seat number.
login.firstTime: First time here, or no password yet? Choose “Email code”.
login.checkInFirst: Sign in to record your attendance for this visit. You will return to it right after.

code.intro: First sign-in: we email a 6-digit code to your university address, then you set a password.
code.sent: If this email belongs to an account without a password yet, or to a student record the faculty registered, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your university email and we will send you a reset code.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes.
forgot.done: Password changed and every session signed out. Sign in with your new password.

setPassword.introFirst: This is your first sign-in. Set a password to use with your email or seat number from now on.
setPassword.introForced: You must replace the temporary password before continuing.
setPassword.policy: At least 10 characters, not containing your email or seat number.

signup.title: Create your student account
signup.intro: Enter your details exactly as on your university records. We first confirm your university email with a code.
signup.emailHint: Your university address. Other email providers are not accepted.
signup.sent: If this address can be used to sign up, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes. If you already have an account, we emailed you how to sign in instead.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Your language is saved to your account and applies on every device.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your sessions on other devices were signed out.
profile.protectedFieldsNote: Your name and seat number come from the faculty's records. To correct them, send a request below; it is applied after approval.

change.title: Correct my details
change.intro: Change only what is wrong, explain why, and send. Nothing changes until the faculty approves it.
change.pendingNotice: Your correction request is waiting for review. You can send another one once it is decided, or cancel it below.
change.noteHint: For example: "My family name is misspelled". Required.

admin.title: Accounts
admin.createHint: The account is created without a password and its owner receives an invitation email. They sign in the first time with an email code, then set a password.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or seat number

detail.suspendHint: Suspending signs the account out of every session immediately.
detail.studentRoleFixed: Student accounts never become staff accounts.
detail.permissionsHint: Defaults come from the role. You can grant an extra permission or withhold one for this account.
detail.noGrantsForRole: This role does not take individual permissions.
detail.self: This is your account; you cannot change its status or role.

verification.title: Account verification
verification.intro: Your university email is confirmed, but your details did not match a student record yet. Until the faculty verifies your account, you cannot see academic information.

verification.stateRejected: Your details could not be verified. Correct them and send them again.
verification.stateNone: Send your details so the faculty can verify your account.
verification.submitHint: If your details match a student record exactly, your account is verified immediately.
verification.submitted: Your details were sent for review.

students.title: Students
students.addHint: Creates the student record. The student then signs in the first time with an email code (if you entered their university email) or signs up and is matched to this record.
students.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, seat number or email

detail.groupHint: A student belongs to one group at a time; choosing another group moves them.

detail.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this account from the record? The student will lose access until verified again.
